findings.body: This adds a new visible answer-context layout and period readout, but the supplied handoff records only a functional browser walk. Neither the task record nor the supplied commit evidence records impeccable's required shape/audit/polish pass or a specifically tasked emil-design-eng interaction checklist. The mandatory batched UI inspection therefore remains incomplete for the changed layout.
findings.title: Not done: impeccable and emil-design-eng UI review
